subject.title: Voice-call plugin: hangup aborts in-flight tool calls (sessions_spawn killed before child initializes)

question: Should voice-call hangup be treated differently from explicit stop/reset once `sessions_spawn` has begun creating an independent child session?
rationale: Current code makes the voice-call run cancellable through normal embedded-run abort paths, while the requested behavior preserves already-independent child work; that boundary changes lifecycle semantics for hangup, stop/reset, and subagent cleanup.

options.title: Decouple accepted spawn from hangup
options.body: Define hangup as ending the voice transport only, then let an accepted or in-progress independent `sessions_spawn` child survive with regression coverage.

options.title: Keep hangup as cancellation
options.body: Treat hangup as deliberate cancellation of all in-flight voice-turn work and document that background work must be queued outside the voice turn.

options.title: Add explicit operator mode
options.body: Preserve current default and add a documented opt-in only if maintainers want a compatibility-preserving background-work mode.

recommendation.title: Decouple accepted spawn from hangup
recommendation.body: Define hangup as ending the voice transport only, then let an accepted or in-progress independent `sessions_spawn` child survive with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent cross-boundary history across voice-call session lifecycle and session helper work, which is where the product decision and likely fix boundary meet.
